# Browser
## Stop: choose the right surface before any browser action
Explicit browser intent wins: if the user names the in-app browser or Chrome, or asks to open, show, or navigate to a page; inspect its visual or interactive state; or interact with its UI, continue with Browser and do not substitute a connector.

Do not initialize Browser for that operation until the query is complete. Use the non-browser tool when available. If it handles the current operation, continue the larger workflow without Browser for that operation. Use Browser when no such tool exists, the tool cannot access the resource or lacks a required capability, or UI work remains; use available browser context before asking the user to repeat it.

Use this skill for browser automation tasks such as inspecting pages, navigating, testing local apps, clicking, typing, taking screenshots, and reading visible page state.

# VFX Reference Dossier — melee_arc (video companion supplement)

## Candidate 1: Grim Scythe (Diablo 3)
- source_game: Diablo 3
- skill_or_mtx_name: Grim Scythe
- primary_url: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=aWvMqUT9MQ8
- media_type: video
- temporal_coverage: windup=Y; active=Y; impact=Y
- why_it_fits: This dedicated Grim Scythe and Leech clip shows the reference-of-record attack repeatedly: the Necromancer initiates a broad sweep, the giant spectral blade traces the weapon path, and enemies react at contact. Because it is a short, skill-specific demonstration rather than a longer showcase, no seek timestamp is needed.
- readability_notes: The pale scythe silhouette and nearly semicircular trail remain readable against Diablo 3’s dark battlefield. The frontal fan and effective reach are immediately apparent from the normal gameplay camera.

## Candidate 2: Moonstone Axe normal attack combo — Aspect of Melinoë (Hades II)
- source_game: Hades II
- skill_or_mtx_name: Moonstone Axe normal attack combo — Aspect of Melinoë
- primary_url: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=K8h8MksLWRU&t=93s
- media_type: video
- temporal_coverage: windup=Y; active=Y; impact=Y
- why_it_fits: At 01:33, the Moonstone Axe segment demonstrates slow, committed sweeping attacks whose curved trails directly follow the physical axe head, including anticipation, traversal, and contact. The first two combo swings are especially useful references; the later overhead finisher belongs to a different melee shape.
- readability_notes: Hades II’s clean top-down staging makes the sweep direction, radius, and cadence exceptionally legible. The trail supports the weapon motion without separating into an independently traveling ribbon.

## Candidate 3: Tempest Slash (Lost Ark)
- source_game: Lost Ark
- skill_or_mtx_name: Tempest Slash
- primary_url: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lYrecr253lY&t=67s
- media_type: video
- temporal_coverage: windup=Y; active=Y; impact=Y
- why_it_fits: At 01:07, the timestamped no-commentary skill showcase isolates Tempest Slash and shows its preparation, successive greatsword-driven arc cuts, and hits on targets. It is a more energetic multi-sweep interpretation than Grim Scythe, but the arcs remain visibly caused by the weapon motion.
- readability_notes: The large sword, forward movement, and repeated curved slashes read clearly at Lost Ark’s gameplay zoom. Its additional energy treatment makes it a useful upper-bound reference for spectacle, though less restrained than the Diablo 3 anchor.

- Searched: `Diablo 3 Grim Scythe skill showcase video YouTube`, `Diablo 3 Necromancer Grim Scythe runes video`, and exact-title/YouTube variants; found the dedicated MeinMMO Grim Scythe clip and several longer build videos.

- Searched Grim Dawn `Blade Arc`; found a dedicated skill overview, but no independently published timestamp identifying its gameplay demonstration, so it was not promoted.
- Searched Last Epoch `Swipe` and sweep showcases; found a long Swipe guide, but no reliable timestamp isolating complete attack footage.
- Searched Hades II Moonstone Axe showcases; found a chaptered all-aspects video with the Aspect of Melinoë segment at 01:33.
